command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
RANKS=${GMX_RANKS:-16}
OMP=${GMX_OMP:-1}
echo "== benchMEM: 81,743 atoms, PME, Berendsen NPT, 10,000 steps (20 ps) =="
gmx_mpi --version 2>/dev/null | grep -E "^GROMACS version|^SIMD instructions" || true
T0=$(date +%s)
mpiexec -n "$RANKS" --allow-run-as-root --oversubscribe \
  gmx_mpi mdrun -s benchMEM.tpr -deffnm bm -ntomp "$OMP" -nb cpu -pin off > mdrun.out 2>&1
T1=$(date +%s)
WALL=$(( T1 - T0 ))

# GROMACS reports the decomposition it ACTUALLY used. conda-forge ships nompi builds at higher
# build numbers than the openmpi ones, so an unpinned solve can hand back a serial binary that
# under `mpiexec -n 4` runs four independent rank-0 simulations -- each printing plausible
# physics. Reading the rank count back is what proves the parallelism happened.
GOTRANKS=$(awk '/Using .* MPI process/{print $2; exit}' bm.log)
GOTOMP=$(awk '/Using .* OpenMP thread/{print $2; exit}' bm.log)
SIMD=$(awk -F: '/SIMD instructions/{gsub(/^ +| +$/,"",$2); print $2; exit}' bm.log)
NSDAY=$(awk '/^Performance:/{print $2; exit}' bm.log)
STEPS=$(awk '/statistics over/{print $3; exit}' bm.log)
[ -z "$STEPS" ] && STEPS=$(awk '/Statistics over/{print $3; exit}' bm.log)
TEMP=$(awk '/Conserved En\./ && /Temperature/{getline; print $4; exit}' bm.log)
EPOT=$(awk '/Coul\. recip\./ && /Potential/{getline; print $5; exit}' bm.log)
NATOMS=$(head -2 bm.gro | tail -1 | tr -d ' ')
{
  echo "system            benchMEM (81,743 atoms, PME, Berendsen NPT)"
  echo "steps             $STEPS  want 10001 (the tpr's own 10,000 steps)"
  echo "ranks_requested   $RANKS"
  echo "ranks_used        $GOTRANKS  want $RANKS  (proves MPI, not a nompi fallback)"
  echo "omp_per_rank      $GOTOMP  want $OMP"
  echo "simd              $SIMD"
  echo "ns_per_day        $NSDAY"
  echo "wall_s            $WALL  (mdrun only)"
  echo "mean_temperature  $TEMP K  want 280..330"
  echo "mean_potential    $EPOT kJ/mol  (decomposition-invariant; see the sweep)"
  echo "confout_atoms     $NATOMS  want 81743 (no atoms lost)"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt
test "$GOTRANKS" = "$RANKS"
test "$GOTOMP" = "$OMP"
test "$NATOMS" = '81743'
awk -v n="$NSDAY" 'BEGIN{exit !(n>0)}'
# physically sane temperature for a 300 K membrane system; a broken run lands nowhere near
awk -v t="$TEMP" 'BEGIN{exit !(t>280 && t<330)}'
echo 'SMOKE CHECK PASSED'
